sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cath Paluc, or Paluc's Cat, is a monster of Welsh mythology. It appears in cat form. It ate 180 men at every meal. Such cats recur across Celtic folklore. Some writers argue these tales show a cat cult of old. They see Cath Paluc as a surviving trace of that cult.

okr.objective: Cath Paluc is a ravenous Welsh cat tied to an old cat cult.
key_results: It is a monster of Welsh lore shaped like a cat.
It devoured 180 men at each meal.
